title: What My Scholarship Taught Me
topic: ประสบการณ์ส่วนตัว
lines: When I received a scholarship to study at university, I thought the hard
part was over. I was wrong. The scholarship paid my tuition, but **it**
also required me to keep a GPA of 3.0 and work ten hours a week in the
university library. In my first term, I struggled with both.
My biggest problem was time. Between classes, library shifts and the long
bus ride home, I had almost no time to study. My grades began to fall,
and I was afraid of losing **everything**. A senior student who also worked
in the library noticed. **She** showed me how she planned her week, hour
by hour, and how she used quiet times at the library desk to review notes.
I copied **her** system. It was not easy at first, but by the end of the
year my GPA had risen to 3.4. More importantly, I had learned to manage
my time, a skill **that** has helped me in every part of my life.
Now I am the senior student. When I see a new scholarship student looking
tired and worried, I do what **she** did for me.
